mapper.insert: INSERT INTO eval_result (task_id, trace_id, query_text, standard_answer, actual_answer, recall_score, precision_score, f1_score, top3_hit_rate, answer_similarity, faithfulness_score, relevance_score, hallucination_flag, completeness_score, overall_score, eval_detail, create_time) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{traceId}, #{queryText}, #{standardAnswer}, #{actualAnswer}, #{recallScore}, #{precisionScore}, #{f1Score}, #{top3HitRate}, #{answerSimilarity}, #{faithfulnessScore}, #{relevanceScore}, #{hallucinationFlag}, #{completenessScore}, #{overallScore}, #{evalDetail}, #{createTime})

INSERT INTO eval_result (task_id, trace_id, query_text, standard_answer, actual_answer, recall_score, precision_score, f1_score, top3_hit_rate, answer_similarity, faithfulness_score, relevance_score, hallucination_flag, completeness_score, overall_score, eval_detail, create_time) VALUES
(#{item.taskId}, #{item.traceId}, #{item.queryText}, #{item.standardAnswer}, #{item.actualAnswer}, #{item.recallScore}, #{item.precisionScore}, #{item.f1Score}, #{item.top3HitRate}, #{item.answerSimilarity}, #{item.faithfulnessScore}, #{item.relevanceScore}, #{item.hallucinationFlag}, #{item.completenessScore}, #{item.overallScore}, #{item.evalDetail}, #{item.createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, task_id, trace_id, query_text, standard_answer, actual_answer, recall_score, precision_score, f1_score, top3_hit_rate, answer_similarity, faithfulness_score, relevance_score, hallucination_flag, completeness_score, overall_score, eval_detail, create_time FROM eval_result WHERE task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM eval_result WHERE task_id = #{taskId}
